title: East Nashville- cozy and convenient
description:
Stay close to Nashville’s downtown energy in this modern condo near Broadway. Walk to live music, dining, entertainment, and popular attractions, with Bridgestone Arena, SoBro, The Gulch, and more nearby. Contemporary comforts and a central location make it easy to explore Music City throughout the late-summer and early-fall season.

The space
The Space

Bedrooms: 3
Bedroom 1: King bed with en-suite bathroom
Bedroom 2: Two Queen beds with en-suite bathroom
Bedroom 3: Full bunk bed with trundle, desk area, and adjacent bathroom (shower/tub)
Premium touches: modern fixtures, upscale appliances, and a fully stocked kitchen
Enjoy a private balcony, plus shared rooftop access with a fire pit, and game room!

Guest access
Guest Access -
The condo has a convenient side entrance from the parking lot. You’ll receive a unique door code before check-in. Elevator access to the 3rd floor brings you to Unit #306, located at the end of the hallway.

Location Highlights Easy access to:

Opryland: 5 mins
Airport: 10 mins
Broadway: 15 mins
E+Rose Wellness Cafe-1 block

Good to Know-
This is a 3rd-floor unit; occasional noise from upstairs neighbors may occur.
Though centrally located, this property is best accessed by car.
Embrace Nashville’s culture and comfort in this beautiful condo – your stylish retreat awaits!

Other things to note
Please read before you book!
- This space is a short drive from most places but not very walkable
- This is a 3rd floor unit with neighbors above, so please expect potential noise.
